title: Arkret Consent typed current result Self-Management Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTOs for holder-private consent state serialized by the current governance Station.

consent_grant_request_body.description: Carries one caller-signed ak.consent.grant Event. The current governance Station validates and serializes the update.

grant_event.description: Closed ak.consent.grant Event whose actor_id and authenticated holder are the path holder Principal Control Realm's current authority-root controller. authorization_ref MUST bind the current authority-root authorization. This root_control_only action supports neither separate managed-behalf execution nor grants: controller/agent consent_write delegations, general PCR writes, co-owner grants, automation, or payload approval evidence do not substitute. The service MUST submit these exact bytes through authority Event submission and MUST NOT co-sign, rebuild or synthesize the Event. Admission MUST verify the authority-root binding, event.realm_id, and path holder; otherwise it rejects unauthorized.

consent_revoke_request_body.description: Carries one caller-signed ak.consent.revoke Event. The current governance Station applies it after the current consent revision without authority-ordered keyed set dots.

revoke_event.description: Closed ak.consent.revoke Event whose actor_id and authenticated holder are the path holder Principal Control Realm's current authority-root controller. authorization_ref MUST bind the current authority-root authorization. This root_control_only action supports neither separate managed-behalf execution nor a controller/agent consent_write delegation or general PCR/co-owner grant. Its payload.consent_id MUST equal the consent_id of the ak.consent.grant being revoked. The service MUST submit these exact bytes through authority Event submission and MUST NOT co-sign, rebuild or synthesize the Event.

consent_request_request_body.description: Body for opaque contact/consent request submission. The peer is the exact authenticated ActorId and is never caller-supplied. Holder existence is deliberately not a precondition visible to the caller.

holder_account_id.description: Exact target AccountId. The same principal hosted by another Station is a different holder and MUST NOT hit this request or its rate-limit/cache key.

consent_scope.description: Requested scope, taken from the section 4 enum minus invite. An invite-scope request has no carrier here: it would have to become a holder_quarantine entry whose surface_kind is consent_request, and that branch pins consent_scope away from invite because an invite belongs to invite delivery. Rejecting it at the request boundary keeps the server from inventing a behaviour for a scope it can never store.

consent_request_outcome.description: Constant anti-enumeration response. Missing holder, denial, rate-limit drop and quarantine acceptance all return this exact shape; no typed current result id, state, dots, timestamps or expiry are exposed.
